pi.name: Swapan K. Nath, Ph.D.
pi.blurb: Professor in OMRF's Arthritis & Clinical Immunology Research Program and holder of the William H. & Rita Bell Chair. His group has helped map lupus genes including ITGAM, CDKN1B, NCF2 and KLF2, and now studies how the risk variants work.
